skills.name: Lunatic - Discharge
lines: Activate Lunatic with Status Static on user (3 turns)
* 50% SPD up on self, diminishing with other SPD buffs.
* Inflict Shock on enemies when attacking (5 turns, 100% chance).
** When enemies have Shock: each attack from any party member increases AF combo% by additional 4% per hit per target. Lunatic - Charge additional attacks are not counted.
* Replaces the basic attack until used (1 activation)

** 15 stacks (max): hit multiplier is 560% (Total 1120% in normal mode, 2240% in Lunatic mode)

* Max stacks: 15
* Stacks last for 1 turn only
